entry.name: rnbo_t60time
entry.digest: Returns t60 time for sample-rate multiplier.
entry.description: Estimates the decay time (in samples) of a given decay factor. That is, given a multiplier X, returns a number T such that, after T multiplications of a signal by X, that signal would be attenuated by 60 decibels. It is the complement of the t60 object.

arguments.name: multiplier
arguments.description: The decay factor to estimate the duration of. The output of the t60 object can be used to generate this value.
